statement: The pinned xpadneo source maps the Xbox logo usage to BTN_MODE, but maps the Share usage through an internal BTN_SHARE alias for keyboard KEY_F12. By default it routes Share events to a separate keyboard input device and clears that code on the gamepad; optional mouse mode can intercept Share as a mouse task button, while learning the battery report ID from the descriptor and exposing Linux power-supply properties. Its README confirms the F12 shortcut; this is not the stock xpad gamepad KEY_RECORD shape.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
